title: Welcome to JSONdb
content:
# Getting Started with JSONdb

Welcome to your JSONdb instance! This is a high-performance document database designed for modern applications.

## Quick Start

1. **Browse Collections** - Navigate to the Browser tab to explore your data
2. **Monitor Performance** - Check the Metrics tab for real-time insights
3. **Manage Security** - Configure users and roles in the RBAC section
4. **API Documentation** - Find comprehensive API docs in the API tab

## Key Features

- **Document Storage** - Store JSON documents with automatic indexing
- **Real-time Metrics** - Monitor database performance and usage
- **Role-Based Access** - Fine-grained permission control
- **RESTful API** - Simple and intuitive API endpoints
- **Binary Persistence** - Efficient storage with automatic saves

## Need Help?

Check out the [API Documentation](/api) or visit our [GitHub repository](https://github.com/your-repo/jsondb).

*You can dismiss this panel by clicking the X button. To re-enable it, update the configuration in the `_config` collection.*
